adverse_media.title: eMudhra security certificate flaw: What Chrome, Firefox users must know
adverse_media.excerpt: The company has maintained that its infrastructure had not been compromised, no data breach had occurred and its physical and logical security controls remained intact. “However, this may have some reputational risks on eMudhra which cannot be quantified,” it added. The company said the incident had no connection with its Indian digital signature certificate and eSign businesses, which operate on separate infrastructure.
